about_item: 35-Day Tick & Flea Defense: Simparica is a tasty, once-a-month chewable that protects your dog from ticks and fleas for 35 days¹, ensuring your dog stays protected, even if the next dose is a few days late.
Kills 5 Types of Ticks: A monthly flea and tick chewable approved to kill 5 types of ticks including the Gulf Coast tick, Brown dog tick, Deer tick, American dog tick, and Lone Star tick.
FDA-Approved to Prevent Lyme Infections: FDA-approved to block infections that may cause Lyme disease by killing deer ticks.

Works Fast: Studies show that Simparica starts killing fleas in 3 hours and ticks in 8 hours.² Simparica kills adult fleas before they can lay eggs providing much-needed, fast relief for dogs with fleas and dogs with flea allergies.
Confidence in Every Dose: Simparica is a tasty pork-liver flavored chewable. Approved for dogs 6+ months of age, weighing 2.8 lbs or more, and backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee on prevention.
